title: Detailed light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="42%" r="38%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFBEA"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#FFE566"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB300"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE566"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#FFCC33"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E69100"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C77B3B"/>
      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#E8A15C"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#F2BF87"/>
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#E8A15C"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C77B3B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="screw" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A66B32"/>
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#D49655"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#D49655"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A66B32"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tip" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8C5A2B"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#BB8047"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8C5A2B"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer soft glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="34" fill="#FFB300" opacity="0.18"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="26" fill="#FFCC33" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- Bulb glass -->
  <path d="M34 42
           C34 24 42 16 50 16
           C58 16 66 24 66 42
           C66 52 62 58 56 63
           L56 68
           L44 68
           L44 63
           C38 58 34 52 34 42 Z"
        fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#FFE98A" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Inner glow highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="34" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#FFF6C0" opacity="0.55"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="30" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Filament support wires -->
  <line x1="45" y1="36" x2="45" y2="56" stroke="#E69100" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="36" x2="55" y2="56" stroke="#E69100" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Filament coil -->
  <path d="M45 40
           L47 44 L45 48 L47 52 L45 56"
        fill="none" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M55 40
           L53 44 L55 48 L53 52 L55 56"
        fill="none" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M45 56 Q50 60 55 56" fill="none" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M45 40 Q50 36 55 40" fill="none" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Filament glow dots -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#FFFBEA"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="1.2" fill="#FFFBEA"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#FFFBEA"/>

  <!-- Neck rim -->
  <rect x="43" y="67" width="14" height="3" rx="1.2" fill="#E8A15C" stroke="#F2BF87" stroke-width="0.6"/>

  <!-- Screw base -->
  <rect x="42" y="70" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="url(#screw)"/>
  <rect x="42" y="74" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="url(#base)"/>
  <rect x="42" y="78" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="url(#screw)"/>
  <rect x="42" y="82" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="url(#base)"/>

  <!-- Screw thread highlights -->
  <line x1="42" y1="72" x2="58" y2="72" stroke="#F2BF87" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.7"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="76" x2="58" y2="76" stroke="#F2BF87" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.7"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="80" x2="58" y2="80" stroke="#F2BF87" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Base bottom tip -->
  <path d="M44 86 L56 86 L53 92 Q50 94 47 92 Z" fill="url(#tip)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="91" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#5C3A1E"/>

  <!-- Cute face on the bulb -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="38" r="1.8" fill="#7A5200"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="38" r="1.8" fill="#7A5200"/>
  <circle cx="45.5" cy="37.4" r="0.6" fill="#FFFBEA"/>
  <circle cx="55.5" cy="37.4" r="0.6" fill="#FFFBEA"/>
  <path d="M46 43 Q50 47 54 43" fill="none" stroke="#A67000" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="42" rx="2.5" ry="1.4" fill="#FF9E30" opacity="0.4"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="42" rx="2.5" ry="1.4" fill="#FF9E30" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
